name: Passing Dominoes
description: Passing Dominoes is a variant of Draw Dominoes in which players may pass instead of playing or drawing. Play to the train; lowest pip total wins the hand. First to 101 (2p/partnership) or 61 (3-4p) wins.

overview.description: Passing Dominoes is a variant of Draw Dominoes in which players may pass instead of playing or drawing. Play to the train; lowest pip total wins the hand. First to 101 (2p/partnership) or 61 (3-4p) wins.

history.origins: Passing Dominoes (The Passing Game) is a common variation of Draw Dominoes, one of the early European line domino games that became established in England from the late 1700s alongside the Block Game. This variant adds a third option each turn—to pass instead of playing or drawing—which gives the game its name and introduces bluffing. The rules were contributed by Joe Celko and published online in September 2001.
timeline: 2001: Rules contributed by Joe Celko and published online.
history.evolution: Adds pass option to standard draw dominoes.

setup.players: 2-4. Four can play partnership or individuals.
setup.deck: Double-six set. Last two tiles cannot be drawn.
setup.dealing: 2-3 players: 7 each. 4 players: 6 each. Remainder = boneyard.

rules.objective: Be first to 101 (2p/partnership) or 61 (3-4p). Lowest pip total wins each hand.
rules.gameplay: 1. Draw for lead. 2. Each turn: (a) add tile to either end of train, or (b) draw from boneyard (unless only 2 left), or (c) pass. 3. Doubles played across; not spinners. 4. Hand ends when one dominoes or nobody can play. 5. Score: lowest gets sum of losers' pips minus own total. Tie = no score.
keyRules: Three options: play, draw, or pass.
Cannot draw when boneyard has only 2 tiles.

strategy.basic: Know when to pass, draw, or play. Stack two boneyard tiles to remember not to draw them.
strategy.intermediate: Bluff with draw or pass. Block opponents.
tips: Drawing can be strategic when you have no play.

variations.name: Partnership
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Partnership uses same rules as individual play; no engine parameter changes.

scoring.description: Lowest pip total wins; scores sum of losers minus own. Tie = no score.

synthesis.shortDescription: Draw dominoes with pass option. 101 or 61 to win.
